questions.explanation: When both parties share the same secret, encryption and decryption use the same key, which makes the operation fast and suitable for bulk data. The difficulty is distributing that secret securely in the first place. Asymmetric methods solve key distribution but are much slower, so practical systems usually combine the two. The concrete addresses in the case do not change the rule.
